IIEST Shibpur Research Associate Selection Process 2026
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IIEST Shibpur Research Associate Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for this IIEST Shibpur recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Research Associate. This is a contractual position offered by the Indian Institute of Engineering Science & Technology.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Research Associate post in this IIEST Shibpur recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Research Associate position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 1,25,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E/B.Tech in Mining Engineering with relevant specialization (minimum 60% marks or 6 CGPA) and a PhD in a relevant specialization.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Associate post is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q7. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview for the Research Associate position is scheduled to be held on 14th August 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Research Associate role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the location of IIEST Shibpur?
faq.answer: IIEST Shibpur is located in Howrah, West Bengal, with the pincode 711103.
